name: Verify Agentforce icon is visible on mobile viewport
objective: Validate icon displays correctly on 375x667 (iPhone SE)
precondition: User logged in on mobile viewport

steps.description: Set the browser viewport to 375x667 (iPhone SE dimensions)
steps.expectedResult: Viewport is resized to mobile dimensions

steps.description: Log in and navigate to the home page
steps.expectedResult: User is logged in and home page is displayed

steps.description: Verify the Agentforce icon is visible and not overlapping other elements
steps.expectedResult: Agentforce icon is visible, properly positioned, and does not overlap with other UI elements
